wrong_things.title: Wrong Things
wrong_things.giver: Maren, keeper of the north road waystation
wrong_things.description: Small wrong things on the north road: the wisps at the old stones are fading, and a hunter found a Greyfang wolf alive but hollow, grey all through, with empty eyes.

objectives.text: Talk to Maren at the waystation.
Find the hollow wolf east of Greyfang Hollow.
Show the mark to Brannoc, the scout at the stone circle.

outcomes.text: I put the hollow wolf out of its misery. A thread of pale light left it and drifted north. Brannoc says the mark on it is carved on the tall stone of the circle too.
I left the hollow wolf standing where I found it. Brannoc says the mark on it is carved on the tall stone of the circle too.

greyfang.title: The Greyfang Pack
greyfang.giver: Maren, keeper of the north road waystation
greyfang.description: Wolves of the Greyfang pack have been taking carts on the north road. Maren asked me to deal with them. Hunger drives them: the drain has left their prey thin and grey.

objectives.text: Kill the Greyfang wolves north-east of the waystation, or drive them off.
Return to Maren.

outcomes.text: I drove the Greyfang pack off the north road instead of killing them all. Maren paid me anyway; hungry wolves are someone else's worry now.
The north road is safe again. Maren paid me in gold and a healing potion, and told the Riverwatch garrison who to thank.

waking_stones.title: The Waking Stones
waking_stones.giver: Brannoc, a scout of the Riverwatch garrison
waking_stones.description: The old stone circle west of the waystation has been glowing since the new moon, out of season. Brannoc wants to know why, but won't go near it himself. The mark on the hollow wolf is carved on its tallest stone.

objectives.text: Investigate the glowing crystal in the stone circle.
Find three rune shards scattered around the stone circle.
Bring the rune shards to Brannoc.
Return the rune shards to the crystal.
Look into the crystal again.

outcomes.text: I gave the shards to Brannoc for the scholars of Riverwatch. The garrison paid well, and the captain knows my name. And the crystal showed me a thread of light running north into the Thornwood: something is drawing on it.

I returned the shards to the stones. The crystal burns brighter now, and some of its light stayed with me. And the crystal showed me a thread of light running north into the Thornwood: something is drawing on it.
I kept the shards for myself. Brannoc won't forget it, and neither will the garrison. And the crystal showed me a thread of light running north into the Thornwood: something is drawing on it.

bandit_camp.title: Thieves by the Fire
bandit_camp.giver: Brannoc, a scout of the Riverwatch garrison
bandit_camp.description: Bandits have made camp south-west of the old stone circle. The Riverwatch garrison pays a bounty to whoever clears them out.

objectives.text: Clear the bandit camp south-west of the stone circle.
Tell Brannoc.

outcomes.text: The bandit camp is ash and bodies. Brannoc paid the garrison's bounty and promised the captain would hear of it.

ask_forest.title: Ask the Forest
ask_forest.giver: The drain-line, running north from the stone circle
ask_forest.description: Something is drawing magic out of the stone circle along a thread of light that runs north into the Thornwood, where the outlaws live. The garrison won't go in. Someone has to.

objectives.text: Follow the drain-line north into the Thornwood and find the outlaws.
Earn the outlaws' trust: clear the bandit camp, or bring Mirela a crate of garrison supplies.
Hear what Mirela's scouts have seen.

outcomes.text: I cleared the bandit camp, and Mirela of the Thornwood Free told me what her scouts have seen: hooded folk carrying cages in and out of the Old Barrow after dark.
I brought the outlaws a crate of the garrison's supplies, and Mirela of the Thornwood Free told me what her scouts have seen: hooded folk carrying cages in and out of the Old Barrow after dark.
The outlaws took me at my word, or at my wanted notice. Mirela of the Thornwood Free told me what her scouts have seen: hooded folk carrying cages in and out of the Old Barrow after dark.

the_barrow.title: The Barrow
the_barrow.description: Mirela's scouts have seen hooded folk carrying cages in and out of the Old Barrow after dark. Whatever is draining the valley, they're part of it.

objectives.text: Search the Old Barrow, south-west of the waystation.
Find out what the hooded folk were doing there.
Decide what to do with the last caged wisp.

outcomes.text: Behind the barrow's vault the hooded folk had a workshop: empty cages, jars of stolen light, and notes about feeding "the first of them" at the Hollow Oak. I freed the last wisp. It follows me now.

Behind the barrow's vault the hooded folk had a workshop: empty cages, jars of stolen light, and notes about feeding "the first of them" at the Hollow Oak. I took the last wisp's light for myself. It was easy. The outlaws heard.

what_they_made.title: What They Made
what_they_made.description: The notes from the barrow talk about feeding "the first of them" in the dark of the Wanderer, at the Hollow Oak, deep in the Thornwood north-east of the outlaws' fire.

objectives.text: Find the Hollow Oak, north-east of the outlaw camp. Go at night.
Stop what they're making.
Search the stone slab by the oak.
Tell someone what you found: Maren, Brannoc or Mirela.

outcomes.text: I killed the first thing they made, at the Hollow Oak, and it knew me: "you smell like us". The letter on the altar names the Pale Gate. The light I took is still in me, and it pulls north too. The people I told kept their distance.

I killed the first thing they made, at the Hollow Oak. Its stolen light streamed away north. The letter on the altar names the Pale Gate, and its map marks a dozen places across Vaelora. Maren says: eat, sleep, and go and find the second one.

I killed the first thing they made, at the Hollow Oak. Its stolen light streamed away north. The letter on the altar names the Pale Gate, and its map marks a dozen places across Vaelora. Brannoc is taking it to the captain, and the captain will want to know who I am.

I killed the first thing they made, at the Hollow Oak. Its stolen light streamed away north. The letter on the altar names the Pale Gate, and its map marks a dozen places across Vaelora. The Thornwood Free will be watching the roads.

silent_shrine.title: Silent Shrine
silent_shrine.giver: The roadside shrine on the north road
silent_shrine.description: The roadside shrine's healing prayers have stopped working. Folk have stopped leaving candles. Something that used to answer there has gone quiet, or been drawn away.

objectives.text: Pray at the roadside shrine, and read its inscription.
Find light given freely: Wisp Essence (wisps come out at the stone circle by night).
Offer the essence at the shrine.
Pray at the rekindled shrine after dark.

outcomes.text: The shrine burns again, and heals those who pray there once a day. When I prayed in the dark, something answered: not a voice, a pull, from above and to the north. Whatever answers prayers, it's still out there.

lost_wagon.title: The Lost Wagon
lost_wagon.description: A merchant's wagon with a yellow canopy never reached Riverwatch. Someone ran it off the north road.

objectives.text: Find the yellow wagon, off the road north-east of the bandit camp.
Follow the tracks: someone dragged the driver off alive.
Get the driver, Jory, out of the bandits' cage.
Find the strongbox the bandits took.
Settle up with Jory at the waystation.

outcomes.text: I got Jory out of the bandits' cage and my strongbox out of their chest, and paid him double. He says he'll drive for me anywhere. Even north.
I got Jory out of the bandits' cage and my strongbox out of their chest, and paid him his wages, as agreed.
I got Jory out of the bandits' cage and my strongbox back, and paid him nothing. He's walking to Riverwatch to tell every driver there about me.
I freed a driver called Jory from the bandits' cage and gave him back his master's strongbox. Fifty gold, and a merchant on the coast who owes me a favour.
I freed a driver called Jory from the bandits' cage, then kept his master's strongbox for myself. A hundred and fifty gold. He called me a bandit with better manners.

licence_to_burn.title: Licence to Burn
licence_to_burn.giver: Brannoc, a scout of the Riverwatch garrison
licence_to_burn.description: An unlicensed hedge-mage lives in the Thornwood, west of the outlaws' fire. The garrison wants her brought in: lights at night, and goats going missing.

objectives.text: Find the hedge-mage in the Thornwood, west of the outlaw camp.
Arrest her, warn her off, or learn from her.
Report to Brannoc.

outcomes.text: I brought Zora, the hedge-mage, in for the garrison. She came quietly. Brannoc paid fifty, and the outlaws won't forget it.
I warned Zora, the hedge-mage, and she vanished into the Thornwood. Brannoc wrote "gone" in his report. The outlaws heard.
Zora, the hedge-mage, taught me a frost spell, and I told Brannoc I never found her. She's still out there, keeping her fire.

readings.title: Readings Under the Wanderer
readings.giver: Magister Aurel of the Collegium, lodging at the waystation
readings.description: A Collegium magister wants the stone circle measured by night: whether its power is sitting still, as it should, or moving.

objectives.text: Take a reading with the rune-glass at the stone circle, at night (1 of 3).
Take a second reading, on another night (2 of 3).
Take a third reading, on a third night (3 of 3).
Bring the readings to Magister Aurel at the waystation.

outcomes.text: Three nights of readings: the stones' power is being drawn north, steadily, like a river. Aurel paid eighty and says someone at the Collegium will want it buried. He'd like to know who.

the_merciful.title: The Merciful
the_merciful.giver: Brannoc, a scout of the Riverwatch garrison, or the merciful themselves
the_merciful.description: Hooded people have camped in a hollow south-east of the waystation, by a stone marked with a circle split by three lines: the same mark as on the hollow wolf.

objectives.text: Find the hooded camp south-east of the waystation, and decide what to do about it.

outcomes.text: Sister Halina of the Mercy says the wisps are souls in pain, and that her people give them rest. I let them go in peace. There are other stones, she said.
I told the Mercy to leave the valley, and they went. Sister Halina said the wisps are souls in pain. There are other stones.
I fought the Mercy at their stone. Sister Halina slipped away before the end.

brannoc_founded.title: What Riverwatch Was Founded On
brannoc_founded.description: Brannoc's father always said Riverwatch was founded by one of Hallam's own hunters. A roll of the founders' names is kept in a niche at the mouth of the old barrow. Brannoc has never had the nerve to read it.

objectives.text: Read the Riverwatch Roll in the old barrow.
Tell Brannoc what it says.

outcomes.text: Riverwatch was founded by men who hunted the lights and were paid in land for it, and Brannoc's family was among them. I told him the truth. He's thinking about what he guards.
The roll lists Brannoc's family among the hunters who put out the lights. I told him it was only names. He didn't ask to see it.

zora_notebook.title: Her Teacher's Notebook
zora_notebook.description: The Lantern Order burned Zora's teacher, Ilse Marrow, and Inquisitor Hale carries her notebook. Zora wants it back, and won't ask how.

objectives.text: Get Ilse's notebook from Inquisitor Hale on the south road.
Give it to Zora.

outcomes.text: I talked Inquisitor Hale into giving me Ilse Marrow's notebook for nothing, and gave it to Zora.
I bought Ilse Marrow's notebook back from Inquisitor Hale with a 'donation' to the lamp fund, and gave it to Zora.
I took Ilse Marrow's notebook from Inquisitor Hale, the hard way, and gave it to Zora.

down_the_greywater.title: Down the Greywater
down_the_greywater.giver: Jory Vell, barge-hand on Weirholt's docks
down_the_greywater.description: The barge Heron and two others sail upriver at the dark of the Wanderer with sealed crates that hum, and the River Compact's factor won't log them.

objectives.text: Ask Factor Tarle at the counting house what the barges carry.
Look at the Heron's sealed crates on the docks, after dark, when nobody's about.
Follow the cargo into the culvert under the docks.
Decide who gets the smugglers' ledger: Captain Varga, or Factor Tarle.

outcomes.text: I gave Captain Varga the smugglers' ledger. Her men took Tarle at the counting house, and the Heron won't sail at the dark this month. The ledger's last entries go upriver, to the circle split by three lines.
I sold Factor Tarle his own ledger for two hundred gold, and watched him burn it. The Heron sails at the dark, as always. Whatever it carries, it carries north.
I showed Factor Tarle his ledger and wouldn't sell it back. He ran downriver on the Heron before morning. The ledger's last entries go upriver, to the circle split by three lines.

toll_of_the_weir.title: The Toll of the Weir
toll_of_the_weir.giver: Goodwife Ama, at Weirholt's south gate
toll_of_the_weir.description: Sergeant Dace charges farmers four coppers a cart at the south gate when the Compact's board says two, and keeps the difference.

objectives.text: Talk to Sergeant Dace at the south gate.
Stop the double toll: lean on Dace, pay him off, or take the toll ledger from the toll-fort strongbox to Captain Varga.
Tell Goodwife Ama.

outcomes.text: I took Dace's toll ledger to Captain Varga. He's counting latrine buckets now, and Ama's coppers came back to her.
I leaned on Sergeant Dace until he charged the farmers two coppers again. He'd like a word with me after dark.
I paid Sergeant Dace sixty gold to charge the farmers two coppers. For a while.

lanes_fever.title: Fever in the Lanes
lanes_fever.giver: Teodor, an elder of Weirholt's Passengers
lanes_fever.description: A fever in the Lanes, the Passengers' quarter. Physician Fenn blames the Passengers themselves. Teodor thinks it's the water.

objectives.text: Look into the Lanes' well.
Follow the new pipe to the mill.
Convince Physician Fenn it isn't the Passengers, or shut the pipe yourself.

outcomes.text: The fever came from the Compact's new seam-stone millstone, its dust in the Lanes' water. Physician Fenn said so in the square. Some people even listened.
I wedged the Lanes' pipe shut, and the fever eased. Physician Fenn still blames the Passengers, but fewer children are sick.

toll_road_gang.title: The Toll-Road Gang
toll_road_gang.giver: Captain Varga, or an overturned cart on the north road
toll_road_gang.description: Somebody's robbing carts on the woods road north of Weirholt. Captain Varga has a hundred gold for whoever stops them.

objectives.text: Find the gang's camp in the woods west of the north road.
Collect the bounty from Captain Varga.

outcomes.text: I cleared out the gang in the woods and collected Captain Varga's hundred gold. The carters are calling me all sorts of nice things.

the_weirstones.title: The Weirstones
the_weirstones.description: The smugglers' ledger mentions a "Weir-site, at the dark". Across the ford on the east bank stands a ring of old stones: one of the twelve places the lights first touched.

objectives.text: Cross the ford to the Weirstones on the east bank, after dark.
Stop whoever is feeding on the stones.
See what they were feeding, in the middle of the circle.
(Optional) Tell Captain Varga what the letter said.

outcomes.text: The Mercy were feeding a lump of seam-stone on the Weirstones' light. I broke their cage and gave the light back. Their letter, signed V., moves the harvest to the Grieving Fields, where the old site runs deeper.

the_deep_ring.title: The Deep Ring
the_deep_ring.description: The Ashen hear the lights under the Grieving Fields screaming. A sinkhole has opened north-east of Greyfold, and hooded strangers come and go at night.

objectives.text: Find the sinkhole north-east of Greyfold.
Stop the Mercy in the Deep Ring.
Break their engine.
Tell Listener Ysolde.

outcomes.text: Under the Grieving Fields the Mercy had an engine of rune-iron draining dozens of caged wisps into seam-stone. I broke it and let them go. V.'s note sends her people to Ilunhall: the Empress's light-stone is residue, and the Mercy mean to feed it.

the_wisp_finder.title: The Wisp-Finder
the_wisp_finder.description: Corin Dray finds wisps for whoever pays, and lately that's been people in masks.

objectives.text: Ask Corin who pays him.
Get him to stop: talk him round, pay him off, or tell Listener Ysolde.

outcomes.text: I told Corin Dray where his lights were going. He quit, and went to tell Ysolde himself.
I paid Corin Dray a hundred gold to stop selling wisps to the Mercy.
I told Listener Ysolde that Corin Dray sells wisps to the Mercy. He left Greyfold that night.

cairns_of_the_rising.title: Cairns of the Rising
cairns_of_the_rising.giver: Old Hesk, the cairn-keeper of Greyfold
cairns_of_the_rising.description: Three of the cairns raised for the companies that fell in the Ashen Rising have been torn down this year.

objectives.text: Restack the three toppled cairns: west by the old ford, east past the laying grounds, south where the grass won't grow.
Tell Old Hesk.

outcomes.text: I restacked the three toppled cairns of the Rising. Old Hesk gave me his brother's sword.

the_light_in_the_eaves.title: The Light in the Eaves
the_light_in_the_eaves.giver: V.'s note, under the Grieving Fields
the_light_in_the_eaves.description: "Come to me at Ilunhall. The Empress's light-stone needs us more than she knows." V. has gone to the capital, where the great halls glow gold at night.

objectives.text: Go to Ilunhall, by the Imperial Road east of Greyfold.
Find out what's keeping the light-stone lit: ask the eaves-wright on the Long Halls, or the Lantern Order.
Go down through the gate under the Market Steps.
Stop the Mercy in the Undercroft.
Decide what to do with Magister Vessa.
Decide what to do with the conduit feeding the light-stone.
Tell Steward Cassia at the Hall of Spears.

outcomes.text: Magister Vessa gave me her ledger and walked out of the Undercroft. A. promised her a cure; she'd rather know if it's a lie. The ledger points to Karrowdeep.
I let Magister Vessa go. She walked out past the conduit and didn't look back.
I handed Magister Vessa to the Lantern Order. She burns on Lanternfast eve.
I killed Magister Vessa in the Undercroft.
I broke the conduit and the caged wisps went free. Every eave in Ilunhall went dim at once.
I left the conduit running. Ilunhall still glows gold, on the last of the wisps in its cages.
Steward Cassia paid me to keep quiet about the dimming.
I told Steward Cassia I wouldn't keep it quiet. She doesn't think Ilunhall will listen.

the_hundredth_horn.title: The Hundredth Horn
the_hundredth_horn.description: Nob Ashby moves things from where they're not wanted to where they are. Today it's the gold-bound horn in the Long Table's trophy chest.

objectives.text: Take the Hundredth Horn from the trophy chest in the Long Table (or tell Hallmaster Odo about Nob).
Take the horn to Nob on the quay, or back to Hallmaster Odo.

outcomes.text: I stole the Hundredth Horn for Nob Ashby. If I want more work, I'm to knock twice at a window with no lantern on the dark of the Wanderer.
I took the Hundredth Horn and gave it back to Hallmaster Odo, who found that very funny.
I told Hallmaster Odo, and the watch ran Nob Ashby off the quay.

a_verse_in_the_eaves.title: A Verse in the Eaves
a_verse_in_the_eaves.giver: Saelie of the Low Lane, on Ilunhall's quay
a_verse_in_the_eaves.description: The Lantern Order sings that Hallam put the lights out. Saelie says the Rune Bridge remembers it another way.

objectives.text: Read the three rune-stones on the Rune Bridge, at night when the runes are lit.
Bring the words to Saelie on the quay.

outcomes.text: Saelie sang me the third verse of Hallam and the Hundred Lights, the Choir's way: the lanterns were meant to guide the lights home, not to keep them out.
